newsitem.title: GREECE: Telesis coordinates Elval block with funds.
newsitem.headline: Telesis coordinates Elval block with funds.

text.p: Athens stock exchange member Telesis Securities coordinated a block trade of 1.1 million shares in Elval at 2,800 drachmas on Friday, placed mainly with local and foreign institutional investors.
Alpha Brokerage, National Securities and Hermes Securities were also involved in the block trade and placement.
The 1.1 million share placement increases Elval's free float. Proceeds will be applied toward the capital increase currently under way which will be completed September 5.
Telesis advised Elval on its 3.4 billion drachma rights issue -- one for 20 at 2,200 drachmas.
